title: Feedback World Model Enables Precise Guidance of Diffusion Policy
abstract: arXiv:2605.15705v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: World models aim to improve robotic decision making by predicting the consequences of actions. However, in practice, their predictions often become unreliable once the robot encounters states outside the training distribution, limiting their effectiveness at deployment. We observe that execution itself provides a natural but underutilized signal: after each action, the robot directly observes the true next state, revealing the mismatch between predicted and actual outcomes. Building on this insight, we propose feedback world model, an inference-time mechanism that closes the loop between prediction and observation at inference time. Instead of treating the world model as a static open-loop predictor, our method maintains a lightweight feedback state that is updated online to iteratively correct future predictions, compensating for model errors using real-time observations without additional training data or parameter updates. W

translated_title: 反馈世界模型实现扩散策略的精确引导
translated_abstract: 世界模型旨在通过预测动作的后果来改进机器人决策。然而在实践中，一旦机器人遇到训练分布之外的状态，其预测往往会变得不可靠，限制了模型在部署时的有效性。我们观察到，执行过程本身提供了一种自然但未被充分利用的信号：在每次执行动作后，机器人会直接观察到真实的下一个状态，从而揭示预测结果与实际结果之间的不匹配。基于这一洞察，我们提出了反馈世界模型，这是一种在推理时闭合预测与观测之间循环的机制。我们的方法不再将世界模型视为静态的开环预测器，而是维护一个轻量级的反馈状态，通过在线更新来迭代修正未来的预测，利用实时观测来补偿模型误差，而无需额外的训练数据或参数更新。
tldr: 提出反馈世界模型，通过在推理时利用机器人执行后的真实观测在线迭代修正预测误差，无需额外训练数据或参数更新即可实现扩散策略的精确引导。
en_tdlr: Proposes a feedback world model that closes the loop between prediction and observation at inference time, using real-time observations to iteratively correct future predictions and precisely guide diffusion policies without additional training data or parameter updates.
